turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm useless at this but I want to surprise my boyfriend on his birthday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You're not useless, you're asking. Does he light up more with a fancy dinner out, or a cosy night in where you cook?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My head's all over the place. I'll know in sixteen seconds, ask me then.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, for your boyfriend, dinner out or a night in that you cook?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Dinner out. I can't cook to save my life.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No shame in that. Pick somewhere he's mentioned wanting to try and book a corner table.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Unrelated, but I've been gluten free for a year and I really miss proper bread.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Gluten free bread is a different beast, but you can get something good. Start with a flour blend that already contains xanthan gum or psyllium.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It acts a bit like gluten, holding the dough together and trapping air. Bread made with it is far less crumbly.
